issues.problem: Its own homepage describes it as 'the leading Construction & Remodeling company in Dunellen, NJ and surrounding areas' and the company is 'Licensed Dunellen, NJ'. issues.fix: Move to a service-area/out-of-zone section or drop, so the zone list only holds South Plainfield-based businesses.

issues.claim: Excluded-type borderline entries left in the list
issues.problem: Four childcare/preschool entries (Haynes Prep School, Greatstart Early Learning, A Small World Preschool, Creative Kids Academy) sit against the 'schools' exclusion; two food manufacturers (Zina's Fine Foods, Flavor Dynamics, plus Nu-Meat Technology) sit against a literal reading of the 'food' exclusion; Spice Culture Banquet Hall is also a restaurant/caterer. issues.fix: Get an orchestrator ruling on whether licensed childcare and B2B food manufacturers count as eligible; if 'food' and 'schools' are strict, remove those entries.

issues.problem: Conti Enterprises (heavy-civil group), Steelite International USA, Parksite Plunkett-Webster (multi-branch distributor) and Green Star Exteriors (NJ + PA offices, statewide service area) are multinational or multi-branch operations. Green Star's South Plainfield address and phone are confirmed, so it is a genuine zone business, but it is not a small local operator.
issues.fix: Keep the flags already in the notes and let triage check the >500-staff rule before assigning.
